_doc: The control schemes for choosing an element's moves (the owner, 2026-10-05, after playing: "still difficult for a human to switch spells, there's a lot of things going on" -> all three as options next to the keys; kept swipe-friendly for a later touch version). MatchSetup.scheme() / set_scheme() (GameSettings' match section, key scheme), SwayCaster (the routing), Hotbar, BendStrip, RadialWheel, the menus, HowTo and F1 read this file. Every word here is shown to the player: no word from any show. Bots are never affected.

keys.label: Keys
keys.line: 1-4 a move, the same key again its other move; the mouse wheel steps its forms
keys.f1: 1-4 a key's move, the same key again its other move · 5 Mend, again Patch · wheel: the move's three forms

direction.label: Direction
direction.line: let go of the right button holding W, S or A/D: attack, defence or dodge
direction.strip: let go of RMB holding  W attack · S defence · A/D dodge · nothing: the key's move
direction.f1: Let go of RMB holding W: attack · S: defence · A or D: dodge · nothing held: the move on 1-5 (again: its other move; wheel: its forms)

radial.label: Wheel
radial.line: hold %s: every move round a wheel; point at one, scroll its form, let go to ready it
radial.strip: hold %s: the wheel · point, scroll its form, let go · RMB: cast
radial.f1: Hold %s: every move round a wheel · move the mouse to one, scroll its form, let go to ready it · 1-5 still pick a key

simple.label: Simple
simple.line: four moves on 1-4, two forms each: how near the opponent is picks the form as you let go
simple.strip: 1-4 a move · near or far picks its form as you let go · wheel: the next move
simple.f1: 1-4 a move, two forms each: how near the opponent is picks the form as you let go · wheel: the next move

direction._doc: The move cast when the right button is let go with a direction held (forward W, back S, side A or D; none: the key's own move). Each [move, variation]. A touch version maps the directions to swipes.

radial._doc: The wheel's key is the action bend_wheel (Tab by default: unused in the ring; in the duel it takes Tab from the character screen while this scheme is on). The game runs on at full speed while it is open, as the equip wheel (the owner: no slow motion on a wheel).

simple._doc: Four moves per element (the first skill of keys 1-4), two forms each: near when the nearest opponent is within near_m (m) as the right button is let go, else far.
